Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.

bank.Framing: Keep all the hair and shoulders visible in the original photo.

messages.text: Can you help me make this pic fit properly without cutting off parts of me? I always get a little nervous about how a portrait will look once it’s been resized. What I need is a 9:16 Instagram story, with all my hair and shoulders kept in the frame. If you need to fill the extra space, you can use a blurred copy of the same photo behind it. I’m probably overthinking it because I’ve had awkward crops before. Please don’t add any text.
